The '''1949–50 [[La Liga]]''' was the 19th season since its establishment. [[Atlético de Madrid]] conquered their third title.

==Format==
Due to the expansion of the league to 16 teams for the next season, the two last qualified teams played the relegation playoffs against the third and fourth qualified teams of the promotion play-offs from [[1949–50 Segunda División|Segunda División]].
